fees.description: Disconnection fee may apply when vacating your property or if we are required to disconnect your electricity supply. This price is for service in business hours; out of business hours may incur additional fees. Fees are charged by the distributor. See additional fee information for details.

Reconnection fee may apply when reconnecting electricity to your property. This price is for service in business hours; out of business hours may incur additional fees. Fees are charged by the distributor. See additional fee information for details.
Credit card or direct debit card processing fee all payments with Visa and Mastercard (domestic)
Credit card processing fee all payments with AMEX (domestic)

Connection fee may apply when moving into your property and connecting electricity to your property (or reading your meter where applicable). This price is for service in business hours; out of business hours may incur additional fees. Fees are charged by the distributor. See additional fee information for details.

electricityContract.variation: If we are going to vary your Rates, we will provide you with written notice of the variation as soon as practicable  or no later than your next bill or in accordance with any applicable laws and codes.
